rows.text:
Initial Villagers: 
1 villager goes on single tree (gathers 8 wood and then helps build mining camp)
1 villager builds mining camp and then goes on gold
1 villager builds monument near hunt or near TC if the hunt is aggressive
rows.note:
Pharoah empowers building monument and then leave it on Granary
As a non necessary extra you can swap the Pharoah between Granary and Bonument between food drops
- if you can do this for 2 rounds of drops you can immediately research Sacred Cats upon ageup
Research Pickaxe once you have 6 villagers on food
At 150 gold. 2 gold villagers build a Temple

rows.text: Transfer villagers from food to gold except for 2
Set TC villager rally point back to food

Send 7 villagers from gold and Pharoah to build 2nd TC
Build a House
